summary: Ubiquiti Inc. filed an 8-K reporting June 30, 2026 fiscal Q4 results and disclosing that on August 20, 2026 the Board extended the expiration of its $500 million August 2025 stock repurchase program from September 30, 2026 to September 30, 2027. No repurchase price, share count, premium, or advisor was stated; the authorization size is unchanged. The filing also references forward-looking statements regarding quarterly cash dividends. The extension preserves buyback capacity and a latent bid under the shares, but timing and pace of repurchases remain discretionary, so the arb angle is limited to supply/demand support rather than a defined event.
